title: VaR at Its Extremes: Impossibilities and Conditions for One-Sided Random Variables
abstract: arXiv:2512.07787v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) may reward diversification at some probability levels and penalize it at others. We study the two extremal regimes in which one effect prevails at every level simultaneously, for sums of one-sided risks. For risks supported on $[0,\infty)$, VaR sub-additivity at all levels, exact VaR additivity and co-monotonicity are equivalent without any integrability assumption; for such risks this removes the finite-mean hypothesis of Imamura and Kato (2026), which cannot be dropped for two-sided risks. Global super-additivity, in turn, is equivalent to first-order stochastic dominance of the aggregate over its co-monotonic counterpart. We factorize this condition through the maximum of independent copies of the margins into negative simplex dependence (NSD), a condition on the joint law that is strictly weaker than negative lower orthant dependence, and simplex dominance (SD) of the aggregator $\Phi(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i=1}

translated_title: 极端情形下的VaR：单边随机变量的不可能性与条件
translated_abstract: 在险价值可能在某些概率水平上奖励分散化，而在其他概率水平上惩罚分散化。我们针对单边风险之和，研究了这两种效应之一在所有水平上同时占主导的两种极端情形。对于支撑在 $[0,\infty)$ 上的风险，所有水平上的VaR次可加性、精确VaR可加性与同单调性在无需任何可积性假设的情况下相互等价；对于此类风险，这去除了Imamura与Kato（2026）的有限均值假设，而该假设在双边风险情形下无法省略。另一方面，全局超可加性等价于聚合风险对其同单调对应部分的一阶随机占优。我们通过边际的独立副本的最大值，将该条件分解为负单纯形依赖——一个对联合分布的限制，严格弱于负下象限依赖——以及聚合器 $\Phi(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i=1}$ 的单纯形支配。
tldr: 该文证明了对非负单边风险，VaR在所有水平上的次可加性、精确可加性与同单调性在无需可积性假设下相互等价，并将全局超可加性通过负单纯形依赖与单纯形支配分解为一阶随机占优条件。
en_tdlr: For non-negative one-sided risks, all-level VaR sub-additivity, exact additivity, and co-monotonicity are equivalent without integrability assumptions, and global super-additivity is characterized as first-order stochastic dominance factorized into negative simplex dependence and simplex dominance conditions.
